title: list filter builder: "Add filter" defaults to the hidden Organization field, lists hidden system fields first, and offers both "Is empty" and "Is null"
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: showcase Tasks list → Filter → *Add filter*.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- The new condition defaults to field **Organization** (`organization_id`, `hidden: true`).
- The field list (25 entries) starts with system fields — Organization, Created By, Last Modified At, Last Modified By, Owner, Owning Business Unit — before Title, and includes hidden ones (Organization, Owning Business Unit, *Search Index* `__search`).
- For a select field the operators are Equals, Does not equal, **Is empty, Is not empty, In, Not in, Is null, Is not null** — "empty" and "null" read the same to an end user.

## Expected

Hidden fields are not offered; business fields come first (the view's columns, then the rest), system fields grouped last; one empty-check pair per field type unless the type genuinely distinguishes them, with a hint.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Filter the field list by `hidden`, order it by the view's column order, default the first condition to the first visible column, and merge or explain the empty/null operators.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *filter builder default field organization hidden system fields is empty is null operators*: 4 hits (1 open, 3 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *add filter condition first field is a hidden system field, duplicate empty and null operators in list view filter*: 8 hits (1 open, 7 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11780 (open) — same hidden-system-field leak, filed 2026-10-07 from the same QA pass, but on the Studio form designer and Records grid, not the list filter builder field picker
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#7561 (closed) — filter-builder operator vocabulary family (prior fix); does not cover the Is empty / Is null overlap or the default field
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#4744 (closed) — prior Is null operator fix in the same list filter; different defect
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10790 (closed) — defines what Is empty compiles to (null or empty string), which is why offering both Is empty and Is null is redundant; different defect
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: filter builder default field hidden organization · system fields first filter · is empty is null duplicate operators
